PRODUCTION-ALIGNED.definition: Capability achieves its catalog goal via the production spine with goal-specific payload.
acceptance_criteria: Live execution returns surface and payload matching catalog goal
No runtime exception; not a generic fallback surface

NOT_COMPLETE.definition: Handler or payload does not achieve the catalog goal for the requested ID.

REUSED-LINK.definition: Catalog declares DUPLICATE / ALREADY_COVERED / REPEAT_CANONICAL for an ID that re-exposes the same goal as a canonical capability. Live execution under the duplicate ID must return a goal-equivalent, user-ready payload — not a generic handler and not a different capability's goal.

PENDING_CANONICAL_AUDIT.definition: REUSED-LINK claim suspended until canonical IDs pass full sequential batch audit.

PENDING_SCOPE_REALIGNMENT.definition: Technical work exists but under wrong official_batch numbering; RTM records true batch.

OVERLAP_BATCH01.definition: ID re-listed in a later batch but completed in Batch 01 spine.

PENDING.definition: Not yet audited under official batch sequential closure.

VERIFIED_COMPLETE.definition: BANNED for 826 RTM `status`/`classification` fields. Legacy cap978 CI closure may still emit `verdict: VERIFIED_COMPLETE` as a separate internal namespace — do not map to RTM without formal registration here.

three_separate_counts.note: Three mutually exclusive RTM columns — never aggregate into a single progress equation

dedup_verification.old_54_826_explanation: Legacy 54/826 = batch01(50) + 4 early batch02 overlap IDs before official batch02 closure; superseded by per_id SSOT with no duplicate IDs
